brief: Portland (Oregon) brand of electric cargo bikes for families (2 kids + groceries), 50-mile range, $4,290 or $99/month lease. Message: the school-and-work run is faster than by car in the city. Target: urban parents 30–45. Channel: Reels/TikTok. CTA: free test ride in store, nomadcycles.com.
